summary: Joe Gaines, signing alongside Walter L. Criley, supports the Department of the Interior's recognition of the problems created by ORVs and its efforts to regulate their use. He takes a conditional stance, endorsing the regulations but insisting they must be carefully analyzed and strictly enforced to protect the integrity of public lands. His comment is part of a broader letter from the Tennessee Department of Conservation raising several specific concerns about the draft Environmental Impact Statement.

statement.text:
It is good to see that the Department of the Interior recognizes the problem that ORV's create and is trying to regulate their use. These regulations should be carefully analyzed and strictly enforced to insure the perpetuation and undiminished integrity of our public lands.
Sincerely,
Walter L. Criley
Joe Gaines
Project Administrator
